votes.motion: Approve the Tuesday, July 20, 2021 Work Session Meeting Minutes
votes.description: The Council approved the work session meeting minutes from July 20, 2021.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 74 of 2021 (Master Plan Amendment and Rezone at 129 S 700 East and 758 East Bueno Avenue) subject to restrictive covenant prohibiting short-term rentals and best efforts to salvage building materials, and direct staff to draft a legislative intent regarding affordable housing policy
votes.description: The Council rezoned properties on Bueno Avenue from SR-3 to RMF-45 and amended the Central Community Master Plan, with conditions protecting against short-term rentals and directing a legislative intent on affordable housing preservation.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 75 of 2021 amending the zoning of properties at approximately 835 South Redwood Road and 1668 West Indiana Avenue from R-1/5000 to R-MU-45
votes.description: The Council rezoned two properties at the intersection of Redwood Road and Indiana Avenue to Residential/Mixed Use District, consistent with the Westside Master Plan's identified Community Node.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 76 of 2021 amending Section 21A.27.040 to allow for commercial uses on rooftops which exceed two stories in the FB-SE Zoning District
votes.description: The Council amended the FB-SE zoning district to permit rooftop commercial uses above the second story when a height of 30 feet is met.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 77 of 2021 amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document for specified items
votes.description: The Council approved Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY2021-22, including funding for risk insurance, air quality programs, COVID building improvements, park rangers, ARPA-funded community programs, a Westside perpetual housing fund, and other items.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 78 of 2021, the 2020 Street Light Master Plan, with qualifications regarding wireless cell facilities on light poles and inclusion of the dark skies Statement of Intent
votes.description: The Council adopted the 2020 Salt Lake City Street Lighting Master Plan with conditions to evaluate wireless cell facilities on city light poles and to include the department's dark skies Statement of Intent in the final adopted plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 51 approving the extension of emergency declaration Proclamation B of 2021 until Friday, March 25, 2022
votes.description: The Council extended the Mayor's COVID-19 local emergency declaration, along with the related mask order for K-12 schools, through March 25, 2022.

The Council approved the consent agenda, which included board appointments for Michael Mejia to the Art Design Advisory Board and Andy Robertson to the Business Advisory Board, and set a public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 5.
